title: merge-resolve outcome
description: The outcome of the merge resolution session (merge-resolve.md), its final message (F-68 D2). resolved: false is a problem bl rolls the merge back for, with the reason; bl checks every merge itself either way.

summary.description: One line: what the session did.

resolved.description: true when every merge is committed and every worktree is clean.

reason.description: Why a merge is not resolved, in one line. reason is a string exactly when resolved is false, and null when resolved is true.
